fields.description: Legal name of the account holder as registered with the bank. This name will appear on member bank statements.
fields.label: Bank Account Holder Name

fields.description: Bank account number (IBAN) where direct debit payments will be collected. Example: NL91ABNA0417164300
fields.label: Company IBAN

fields.description: Bank Identifier Code (BIC/SWIFT). Optional - can be automatically derived from Dutch IBANs. Example: ABNANL2A
fields.label: Company BIC/SWIFT (Optional)

fields.description: Default cash account for payment processing
fields.label: Default Cash Account

fields.description: Bank account for Mollie payment processing. If not set, will look for an account named 'Mollie' or fall back to company default bank account.
fields.label: Mollie Bank Account

fields.description: Parent account group under which Ponto bank accounts will be created. Default: Bankrekeningen
fields.label: Ponto Bank Account Parent Group

fields.description: Bank account for ING Checkout (Pay.nl) payment processing. Required for iDEAL and Direct Debit payments.
fields.label: ING Checkout Bank Account

fields.description: Account for accepting membership payments
fields.label: Membership Dues Payment Account

fields.description: Income/Revenue account for membership dues. This should be a Profit & Loss account with type 'Income Account'.
fields.label: Dues Income Account

fields.description: Default receivable account for membership dues invoices. If not set, will use Company default receivable account.
fields.label: Dues Payments Receivable Account

fields.description: Template for Mollie subscription description. Available placeholders: MEMBER_ID (member ID number), MEMBER_NAME (full name)
fields.label: Mollie Subscription Description Template

fields.default: Membership dues MEMBER_NAME (MEMBER_ID) - COVERAGE_START to COVERAGE_END
fields.description: Template for Ponto payment request description. Available placeholders: MEMBER_ID (member ID number), MEMBER_NAME (full name), COVERAGE_START (coverage period start date), COVERAGE_END (coverage period end date)
fields.label: Ponto Payment Description Template

fields.description: Naming pattern for SEPA Mandate References (mandate_id) communicated to banks. Use Frappe naming series format with dots. Example: MANDATE-.YY.-.MM.-.####
fields.label: SEPA Mandate Naming Pattern

fields.description: SEPA Creditor Identifier (Incassant ID) issued by your bank for direct debit authorization. Format: NL + 2 check digits + ZZZ + up to 11 alphanumeric characters (18 chars total). Example: NL60ZZZ12345678002
fields.label: SEPA Creditor ID (Incassant ID)

fields.description: Starting number for SEPA mandate counter. Set this to control where numbering begins (e.g., 1000 to start from MANDATE-25-01-1000).
fields.label: SEPA Mandate Starting Counter

fields.description: Comma-separated list of days of the month (1-31) when batches should be created. Example: '1,15' for 1st and 15th of each month
fields.label: Batch Creation Days

fields.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses for SEPA batch notifications. Example: 'treasurer@org.com,finance@org.com'
fields.label: Financial Admin Emails

fields.description: JSON configuration for batch optimization parameters
fields.label: Batch Optimization Configuration

fields.description: Timestamp of the last automated batch creation
fields.label: Last Batch Creation Run

fields.description: General contact email for notifications and communications
fields.label: Contact Email

fields.description: Enable strict period mode for SEPA batch processing - prevents overlapping payment periods
fields.label: SEPA Strict Period Mode

fields.description: Automatically create SEPA Direct Debit batches on specified days
fields.label: Enable Automatic Batch Creation

fields.description: Comma-separated list of IP addresses allowed for SEPA operations (for security)
fields.label: SEPA Allowed IP Addresses

fields.description: Default item group for membership items
fields.label: Default Item Group

fields.description: Number of days from coverage period start date to set as invoice due date. Used when no Payment Terms Template is configured.
fields.label: Default due date (days from coverage start)

fields.description: Skip automatic Payment Entry creation for Membership payments. Warning: May cause accounting issues.
fields.label: Skip Automatic Membership Payment Entries

fields.description: Enable SEPA Direct Debit as a payment method. Requires Company IBAN and SEPA Creditor ID to be configured.
fields.label: Enable SEPA Direct Debit

fields.description: User account for webhook operations. Should have minimal permissions.
fields.label: Webhook User

fields.description: Stop setup_webhook_user (after_install/after_migrate) from creating, re-enabling or reconfiguring the webhook service user. Set this if the account is deliberately disabled or managed manually.
fields.label: Disable Webhook User Auto-setup

fields.description: Webhook secret for ING Checkout (Pay.nl) webhook verification. Configure this in the Pay.nl admin panel.
fields.label: ING Checkout Webhook Secret

fields.description: Configure keywords used to classify incoming Mollie payments by type
fields.label: Payment Classification Keywords

fields.description: Comma-separated keywords to identify membership dues payments (e.g., contributie)
fields.label: Membership Dues Keywords

fields.description: Comma-separated keywords to identify donation payments (e.g., donation, donatie)
fields.label: Donation Keywords

fields.description: Comma-separated keywords to identify shop/WooCommerce order payments (e.g., bestelling, order)
fields.label: Order Keywords
